title: Shooting React Parity Restore
description: Restore the shooting app to premigration feature parity for the React renderer (see git tag `premigration`). The Rust-plugin migration dropped: real icon rendering (GLB render via iconRenderPort, replaced by placeholder SVG emblem), fixture-driven lighting/material in the model viewport, saved cameras, per-shot cameras, center-model/auto-fit, shot-frame overlay, projection switch, window measures/engagements/toolbar, the modern setHover/worldPick selection protocol, and file import/export. Close these gaps via generic extensions: World3dScene gains optional environmentJson/frameJson/fitJson; new generic icon-render component host in the shared React renderer; new iconRenderExport renderer op; requestFileOpen readAs:dataUrl and downloadMediaExport encoding:base64 root fixes; full command/measure/engagement/tool parity in shooting/plugin/rs/lib.rs. Store/Restore (localStorage) intentionally dropped per dev decision — persistence is the kernel's job.
summary:
Re-verified end-to-end after the compile break blocking all shooting dev sessions was fixed. Root cause: `ui/wgpu/rs/lib.rs` added a `loading: Option<bool>` field to `UiTreeSectionNode`/`UiTreeItemNode`/`UiTreeNode` (concurrent session), and `shooting/plugin/rs/lib.rs`'s 7 struct literals (tree_item_with_action, build_document_tree, build_catalogue_tree) weren't updated to match — `cargo check -p shooting-plugin` failed with E0063 on all 7. Added `loading: None` to each, matching the convention already used in puzzle/plugin. `cargo check -p shooting-plugin` and the wasm32-wasip2 release build now succeed.

Separately found `dev:shooting:base-icon` (used by the shooting-react-dev/shooting-wgpu-dev launch.json entries) was broken: the trailing "fixture base-icon" args are never consumed by framework/product/os/dev/📜️script.ts's DevScript and leak straight through to Vite's CLI, silently overriding its `root` to a nonexistent directory — every asset 404s while Vite reports "ready". Same bug likely affects dev:puzzle:3d/5d:concrete-forest, dev:cad:concrete-forest, dev:procedural:3d:hexagonal-column. Worked around by switching shooting-react-dev/shooting-wgpu-dev in .claude/launch.json to plain `dev:shooting` (no fixture args); filed a separate follow-up task for the root passthrough bug rather than fixing it here (out of scope, affects multiple apps).

Verified shooting end-to-end in the browser via the fixed dev:shooting server: app boots, 3D scene renders with correct fixture-driven lit material once a GLB asset is added (Catalogue > Add Asset > GLB Asset), Catalogue > Add Shot (SVG/PNG rectangle/ellipse) creates a new shot and the Icon panel renders a real SVG preview, Document tree shows Shots/Assets sections populated. A handful of benign "[DEBUG] action failed" console errors appear once at boot (React StrictMode double-invoking the auto setActiveExample("") reset effect) but don't recur on any subsequent interaction and don't block functionality. Noticed but did not fix: Document-tree shot selection doesn't visibly resync the Icon panel's active shot (filed as its own follow-up).
